name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 10 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-06-06, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
